determinism.newline_normalization: CRLF and CR become LF before parsing and hashing
determinism.ordering: paths, modules, edges, candidates, SCCs, and JSON keys are sorted

dynamic_alias_policy.control_flow_merge: if/try branch bindings are visited in deterministic source order; conflicting branch aliases remain heuristic
dynamic_alias_policy.lexical_scopes: module, class, function, and lambda bindings are tracked; class namespaces are skipped for nested function lookup

module_graph_policy.duplicate_policy: collapse by source and target path
module_graph_policy.type_checking_policy: exclude edges nested in if TYPE_CHECKING body from runtime graph, SCC, public surface, and Registry runtime taxonomies
